prompt_text: Square 1:1 promotional product image for an Indian online seller. A clean studio product photo of a neatly folded red cotton kurti on a plain warm-white background, soft daylight, subtle shadow. Put a saffron circular discount badge in the top-right corner containing exactly this text in Devanagari script: 50% छूट. Put the price exactly as ₹799 in bold black text at the bottom-left. Minimal, modern, ready to post on a marketplace listing.

settings.note: Prompt text is byte-identical across all three models. Aspect ratio is 1:1 everywhere (Gemini aspectRatio=1:1). No negative-prompt or style parameters are used anywhere, because not every model supports them.
